title: Analytic: mode volume and Purcell factor of a filled PEC box (E_z FDFD eigenfrequency)
description:
A rectangular PEC box of a x b = 2 x 1.2 um (101 x 61 cells of 20 nm; pec pins E_z at the centres of the outer cells, so the walls are dx/2 inside the domain) filled with a lossless dielectric eps_fill, solved by the eigenfrequency study (em_fdfd_ez) at the discrete (1, 1) wavelength. The resonance field is scaled to 1 at its peak, the centre cell, so the window sums of sin^2 sin^2 are exact. The sweep runs eps_fill over 1, 2.25 and 4.
Analytic (discrete 5-point box): lambda_11 = 2 pi n / K, K^2 = (2/h)^2 (sin^2(pi h/(2a)) + sin^2(pi h/(2b))); W_E = integral of eps0 eps_r |E|^2 / 4 = eps0 eps_fill a b / 16 (J/m); mode volume of eps_r |E|^2 = a b / 4 at the maximum and a b / 2 at the quarter point (|E|^2 = 1/2 there); Purcell factor of an E_z line emitter in 2D F = (Q / (pi^2 V)) (lambda / n)^2 with a parameter Q (the box is lossless), the same at every eps_fill since lambda / n is fixed.
Derived values tab (each figure of merit is a derived value reading the ones listed before it): W_E, W_H (integral of mu0 |H|^2 / 4, = W_E at resonance; the wall cells average one H face, ~1 %), V_max, V_quarter, E2_centre, lam (resonance_table row 0), purcell; expect ~1e-5 for W_E, V, E2 and lam (float32 fields), purcell as lam and V.
Sweep tab: W_E and purcell vs eps_fill with the dashed analytic lines (W_E grows with eps_fill, purcell stays flat).

parameters.name: a_box
parameters.description: box width between the E_z walls (101 cells)

parameters.name: b_box
parameters.description: box height between the E_z walls (61 cells)

parameters.name: Q_assumed
parameters.description: quality factor for the Purcell formula (the PEC box itself is lossless)

parameters.name: x_wall
parameters.description: position of the x_lo / y_lo E_z wall (centre of the outer cell)

parameters.name: K_11
parameters.description: discrete (1, 1) wave number in the filling [rad/m]

parameters.name: lambda_11
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the discrete (1, 1) mode (eigen target)

parameters.name: W_E_ref
parameters.description: stored electric energy per length [J/m] of a peak-1 field

parameters.name: V_max_ref
parameters.description: mode volume (area) at the field maximum [m^2]

parameters.name: V_quarter_ref
parameters.description: mode volume at the quarter point (|E|^2 = 1/2) [m^2]
